name: The Cult of the Damned
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: The scourge are a blight on our lands, and their living servants are the worst of them. The people of Tirisfal have enough to deal with between the mindless dead and the Scarlet Crusade. If you wish to do some good, help me put an end to this scum.
narrative.objectives: Kill 8 Dark Neophytes and 8 Dark Enforcers in Tirisfal Glades.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank you for your aid, champion. If we do not wish to see Lordaeron's history repeat itself, we've got to be vigilant when threats like this spring up.
